{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
df_baseline_neg999 = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]
print(f"Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {len(df_baseline_neg999)}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
df_duplicates = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(df_duplicates)}")

# Check association between arm and severity
df_cross = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'], margins=True)
print("Cross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
print(df_cross)

# Compute the distribution of sample_seq per patient
df_seq_count = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Maximum sample_seq per patient: {df_seq_count.max()}")
print(f"Number of patients with sample_seq > 1: {(df_seq_count > 1).sum()}")"}
